sentences.text: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs is a 1937 American animated musical fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Productions and originally released by RKO Radio Pictures . It was a critical and commercial success , and with international earnings of $ 8 million during its initial release briefly assumed the record of highest-grossing sound film at the time .	sound film	sound film
The popularity of the film has led to it being re-released theatrically many times , until its home video release in the 1990s .
